description: Strongest in quiet early openings (about 5-11 stones) where I, the player to move, still have every stone (or all but one) on the bottom row, and the bottom row looks like .OX.XO.: opponent on columns 1 and 5, me on columns 2 and 4, centre column empty, often with opponent stones capping mine on row 1. Near-threshold firing in mid/late games is diffuse and not described. Never fires when I have an immediate win.
effect: Raises column 1 (by about 0.1-0.25 probability) and a little column 5, at the expense of column 2 (and column 4); little effect in forced positions.
notes: Best dev F1 0.181 (P 0.257, R 0.139, AUROC 0.563), simulation share -0.28 (negative for every program tried). Six score calls: row-1 opponent stones (0.145), weighted cell sum (0.165), bottom-row motifs alone (0.08-0.10, precision about 0.5 but recall 0.05), early plus motif (0.181). Minimal pairs: my stacked stones kill firing; O on (0,1) vs (0,0) swings activation from 11 to -0.5; not mirror-symmetric. About 2/3 of firing is mid/late-game near threshold with no bottom-row or column signal I could find. Could be a random direction. Synthesis positions reach 14.9-16.8 (dev max 11.46).
